description: This file implements the Office365CalendarService class, providing methods to interact with Microsoft Graph API for calendar operations such as creating, updating, deleting events, listing calendars, and fetching availability. It manages OAuth tokens, handles API responses, and converts time zones.

classes.name: Office365CalendarService
classes.description: A class implementing calendar operations for Office365 via Microsoft Graph API, including event management, calendar listing, and availability checks.

methods.name: triggerDelegationCredentialError
methods.description: Triggers a webhook for delegation credential errors.

methods.name: getAuthUrl
methods.description: Constructs the OAuth URL for delegated or non-delegated access.

methods.name: getAuthCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves client ID and secret for OAuth token requests.

methods.name: getAzureUserId
methods.description: Fetches the Azure AD user ID for delegated credentials.

methods.name: testDelegationCredentialSetup
methods.description: Tests the setup of delegation credentials by attempting to fetch an access token.

methods.name: getUserEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the API endpoint for the current user or delegated user.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event in Office365.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event.

methods.name: getAvailability
methods.description: Fetches busy times for specified calendars within a date range.

methods.name: listCalendars
methods.description: Lists all calendars accessible via the Office365 account.

methods.name: translateEvent
methods.description: Converts a generic event object into Office365-specific event format.

methods.name: fetcher
methods.description: Performs raw API requests with OAuth authorization.

methods.name: fetchResponsesWithNextLink
methods.description: Recursively fetches paginated responses from batch API calls.

methods.name: fetchRequestWithRetryAfter
methods.description: Retries failed requests after a specified delay, handling rate limiting.

methods.name: apiGraphBatchCall
methods.description: Performs batch API calls to Microsoft Graph.

methods.name: handleTextJsonResponseWithHtmlInBody
methods.description: Parses JSON responses, handling embedded HTML if necessary.

methods.name: findRetryAfterResponse
methods.description: Detects if any response indicates rate limiting (429).

methods.name: processBusyTimes
methods.description: Processes API responses to extract busy time slots.

methods.name: handleErrorJsonOffice365Calendar
methods.description: Handles error responses from Office365 API requests.

methods.name: getMainTimeZone
methods.description: Retrieves and converts the user's main timezone from mailbox settings.
